event: 2026 ILCA 4 Youth European Championship and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The protest time limit for ILCA 4 (Boys) (Red fleet) was 17:30, on 14 Apr 2026 The request for redress was filed by ESP 225052 at 18:04:48.
conclusions: ESP 225052 failed to file the request for redress within the protest time limit, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(1). There was no good reason for the protest committee to extend the time. RRS 61.2(b)(1), 63.4(a)(1), N1.4(b)
decision: The request for redress is invalid; the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
